Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

profile — a short description of a person. Example: This is my profile.
identity — who a person is. Example: My identity card is in my bag.
profession — a job that needs training. Example: My profession is engineer.
language — the words people speak in a country. Example: I can speak three languages.
nationality — the country you belong to. Example: My nationality is Italian.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• My name is ...
• I am from ...
• My profession is ...
• I can speak ...
• My goal is ...
